summary: Evolve the already-implemented Bare Hands calibration into an adaptive voice-first diagnostic/tuning loop with temporary trial profiles, richer telemetry, negative examples, pointing-intent gating, target preselection/assistance calibration, and a separate deterministic Test benchmark with multidimensional before/after scoring.
locked_constraints: Start from current main; do not replay the implemented 2026-09-20 refinement branch.
Measurements remain deterministic; the calibration agent interprets evidence and user feedback but does not invent measurements.
Trial changes are temporary until explicit acceptance and must support rollback.
Normal calibration does not persist raw video, screenshots, or full landmark arrays.
Tracking a hand does not imply pointer visibility; ordinary motion shows no cursor.
Benchmark/Test never mutates settings or profile state.
Scores describe Bare Hands interaction quality, not user skill.
No continuous autonomous learning outside an explicit calibration session.
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary is not exposed; Slice 00 must resolve valid existing Task Types before implementation dispatch.
Voice/agent/MCP/scene code is moving quickly; Slice 00 and every dependent Slice must freshness-check current contracts.
